senses.gloss: f. (סָמָא) closing a cavity, אבן מ׳, v. אֶבֶן.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 69b:24">Nidd. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>באבן מ׳</he> when the apparent corpse lies on a stone under which there is a cavity; <cite ref="Shabbat 82b:4">Sabb. 82ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>מוסמא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). Sifra M’tsora, Zab., Par. 2, ch. III; a. fr.
